outcome: Maternal death from direct pregnancy complications
cohort: 135 Women who died from direct pregnancy complications between 2009 and 2012 in the UK (cases) and 1661 women who survived severe pregnancy complications (controls)
finding: Inadequate use of antenatal care, substance misuse, medical comorbidities, previous pregnancy problems, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and Indian ethnicity were independently associated with maternal death from direct pregnancy complications.
